title: Hybrid search with SPLADE (V2) and vector
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### What would you like to be added?

Support for Hybrid search with SPALDE V2 and vector

### Why is this needed?

A merger of sparse and dense retrieval is now possible through [hybrid search](https://<redacted-host>/docs/hybrid-search), and learnable sparse embeddings help minimize the traditional drawbacks of sparse retrieval.

SPLADE V2 seems to be a lot more promising than BM25.   Since community has already considered BM25 scoring - can we consider SPLADE V2 as well as this is much more efficient than BM25

### Anything else?

_No response_

comments.author: participant4
comments.body:
Milvus has just released a beta version for 2.4, which provides beta support for Sparse Vectors. Feel free to try it out! 

The doc is at https://milvus.io/docs/sparse_vector.md. the new pymilvus SDK also provides an optional `model` module(`pip install pymilvus[model]`), you can use that to easily generate SPLADE sparse embeddings https://milvus.io/docs/embed-with-splade.md. For a complete guide of performing hybrid search on sparse/dense embeddings, see https://github.com/milvus-io/pymilvus/blob/master/examples/hello_hybrid_sparse_dense.py.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
if you can give some evalution that would be interesting, but ideally:
1. it is much slower -> dense embedding is fixed size and usually memory aligned.
2. search quality will be bad -> sparse and dense embedding don't have same dinstance metrics
3. memory usage will be huge.
Unless there is a clue that mix them all together will help, we will be more focus on hybrid search + retrieve + reranking styple
